question: In the Sn-incorporated GST terahertz study, by what factor did the 1 THz conductivity of undoped GST rise from annealing at 150 °C to annealing at 250 °C?
rendered:
The 1 THz conductivity of undoped GST rose from 345.68 S/m at 150 °C to 10577.24 S/m at 250 °C. 

To find the factor by which it rose, divide the conductivity at 250 °C by the conductivity at 150 °C: 

10577.24 / 345.68 ≈ 30.6. 

So, the conductivity rose by a factor of approximately 30.6.
